name: hospital-app
description: Hospital bill generation app - runs both backend and frontend

scripts.install:all: cd nodeApp && npm install && cd ../reactApp && npm install
scripts.start:frontend: cd reactApp && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation npm start
scripts.start:client: cd reactApp && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation npm start
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" --kill-others-on-fail "cd nodeApp && npm start" "cd reactApp && cross-env BROWSER=none NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation npm start" "wait-on -t 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && cd reactApp && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm run electron:dev"
scripts.electron:client: concurrently --names "FRONTEND,ELECTRON" --prefix-colors "magenta,yellow" "cd reactApp && cross-env BROWSER=none NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation npm start" "wait-on -t 30000 tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && cd reactApp && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 STANDALONE_FRONTEND=true npm run electron:dev"
scripts.build:frontend: cd reactApp && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation npm run build
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:frontend && cd reactApp && npm run electron:build
scripts.package:win: npm run build:frontend && cd reactApp && npm run electron:build
scripts.package:main: npm run build:frontend && cd reactApp && npm run electron:build:main
scripts.package:client: npm run build:frontend && cd reactApp && npm run electron:build:client
scripts.package:all: npm run build:frontend && cd reactApp && npm run electron:build:main && cd .. && cd reactApp && npm run electron:build:client
